why_it_is_not_an_n_plus_one: HotROD's -W flag sets the route-service worker pool. At the default of 3 the eleven route calls overlap, so their durations sum to more than the window they occupy. The label is a property of the flag the capture ran under, not a judgement about the trace.
notes: Whole trace, 40 spans across 6 services, nothing removed. Its pair, n_plus_one_full_serial, is the same trace shape captured at -W 1, where the identical group runs serially and the correct answer flips.

The trace also contains a genuine N+1 elsewhere: 13 serial GetDriver calls under the driver service. That is why the trimmed near-miss fixture exists — a whole-trace negative can only be scoped to a named group, which is what expected.parent_span_id does here.
